additional_info.subject: Notes from Customer
additional_info.body: The terminal on this charger is no longer working. The screen is black, but the blue LED is still on. It doesn’t respond, even when pressing the M button at the back. Restarting it doesn’t help—the screen remains black. The logs show the following error: flags PaymentTerminalUnreachable_PZx=true. Additionally, we have no transactions at all. Would a replacement be necessary? If so, could you place the order and arrange for the replacement, please? Thank you in advance
